desc:
⭐️ Welcome to Anime Divine, the ultimate anime clicker! ⭐️

👆 Click to gain power and get stronger with every tap!
⚔️ Collect powerful Swords and master unique Abilities!
✨ Summon legendary Champions to fight by your side!
🍎 Spin for rare Fruits and unlock new powers!
🏰 Clear Dungeons and defeat Bosses for epic loot!
📈 Rank up, ascend and upgrade everything!

You start with nothing but your fists. Train, summon and fight your way through anime worlds until you become DIVINE! 👑

🌍 Explore new Islands with BOATS ⛵ and MOUNTS 🐉
🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Team up with friends and grow faster together! 🎉

🎁 CODES: Release, SorryForShutdown, SorryForShutdown2, SorryForShutdown3, FixingBugs, WeAreBack, FastShutdown

💻📱🎮 Available on computers, phones, tablets and consoles!
